passThrough.title: Pass Through Endpoints
passThrough.description: Configure and manage your pass-through endpoints
passThrough.deleteMessage: Are you sure you want to delete this pass-through endpoint? This action cannot be undone.

methods.label: HTTP Methods (Optional)
methods.hint: Select specific HTTP methods. Leave empty to support all methods (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, PATCH). Useful when the same path needs different targets for different methods.
methods.onlySelected: Only {{methods}} requests will be routed to this endpoint

add.title: Add Pass-Through Endpoint
add.whatIsBody: Route requests from your LiteLLM proxy to any external API. Perfect for custom models, image generation APIs, or any service you want to proxy through LiteLLM.
add.routeConfigDescription: Configure how requests to your domain will be forwarded to the target API
add.includeSubpathsDescription: Forward all subpaths to the target API (recommended for REST APIs)
add.headersDescription: Add headers that will be sent with every request to the target API
add.authHeadersHint: Authentication and other headers to forward with requests
add.authHeadersDescriptionStrong: Add authentication tokens and other required headers
add.queryParamsDescription: Add query parameters that will be automatically sent with every request to the target API
add.queryParamsHint: Query parameters that will be added to all requests. Clients can override these by providing their own values.
add.queryParamsDescriptionStrong: Parameters are sent with all GET, POST, PUT, PATCH requests
add.queryParamsDescriptionExamples: Client parameters override defaults. Examples: version=v1, format=json, key=default
add.performanceDescription: Configure upstream request timeout for this endpoint
add.timeoutHint: Max time to wait for the upstream API to respond. Leave empty to use general_settings.pass_through_request_timeout (default 600s).
add.timeoutDescription: Use a higher value for slow upstream APIs (e.g. 1200 for long-running LLM calls)
add.billingDescription: Optional cost tracking for this endpoint
add.costHint: Optional: Track costs for requests to this endpoint
add.costDescription: The cost charged for each request through this endpoint

info.heading: Pass Through Endpoint: {{path}}
info.timeoutDescription: Max time to wait for upstream response. Leave empty to use the global pass_through_request_timeout (default 600s).
info.toastUpdateFailed: Failed to update pass through endpoint
info.toastDeleteFailed: Failed to delete pass through endpoint

guardrails.title: Guardrails
guardrails.description: Configure guardrails to enforce policies on requests and responses. Guardrails are opt-in for passthrough endpoints.
guardrails.fieldTargetingBody: Optionally specify which fields to check. If left empty, the entire request/response is sent to the guardrail.
guardrails.selectGuardrailsHint: Choose which guardrails should run on this endpoint. Org/team/key level guardrails will also be included.
guardrails.tip: 💡 Tip: Leave empty to check entire payload
guardrails.requestFieldsHintTitle: Specify which request fields to check
guardrails.responseFieldsHintTitle: Specify which response fields to check
guardrails.requestFieldsPlaceholder: Type field name or use + buttons above (e.g., query, documents[*].text)
guardrails.responseFieldsPlaceholder: Type field name or use + buttons above (e.g., results[*].text)

costOptimizationBanner.title: Help shape cost optimization
costOptimizationBanner.description: We're collecting suggestions for cost optimization improvements across routing, budgets, and more. Let us know what you'd like to see.

panel.heading: Auto routers
panel.description: Auto routers sit above your deployments and pick a model per request. They are called like any other model, so clients keep using a single model name.
panel.addDialogDescription: Routes each request to a model by classifying its complexity. Called like any other model, so clients keep using a single model name.
panel.deleteMessage: Are you sure you want to delete "{{name}}"? Any client still calling this model name will start failing.

columns.noBudgetToClear: This access group has no budget to clear
columns.writeBlockedAdmin: Only a proxy admin can change an access group budget
columns.writeBlockedSlash: A budget cannot be set on a group whose name contains a slash

modal.description: Every key granted this access group by name draws from this one budget. A key that reaches the group's models through a wildcard or all-proxy-models is not charged against it.
modal.maxBudgetHint: Total the whole group may spend. Once its shared spend reaches this, every key that draws from the group is refused
modal.softBudgetHint: Fires an alert when the group's spend reaches this. Requests keep succeeding
modal.resetBudgetHint: How often the group's spend resets. Leave empty for a budget that never resets
modal.blankHint: A field left blank keeps whatever the budget already has. Use Clear budget to remove the budget itself.
modal.validation: Set at least one of max budget, soft budget or reset window

panel.emptyDescription: Put a deployment in an access group from its model settings, then give the group a shared budget here.
panel.description: A model access group can carry one budget that every key granted the group by name draws from together. Keys that reach the group's models through a wildcard or all-proxy-models are not charged against it.
panel.clearMessage: Are you sure you want to clear this access group's budget? The recorded shared spend is cleared with it, and the group's models stay available.
